title: A New Car UI: How touch screen controls in cars should work
summary: Matthaeus Krenn presents a concept for car touchscreen UI where the screen controls only one thing at a time, designed to suit driving. A tablet prototype accompanies the short demo.
why: Repeatedly cited in car touchscreen debates as an elegant, sensible alternative to distracting automotive UIs.

quote.text: I feel compelled to share a video, now 9 years old, that shows how touch screens could be accommodated with sensible design in cars.
